description: LLM subscription usage collector — scrapes/APIs provider dashboards (z.ai, Gemini, Kimi, MiniMax, OpenAI, Anthropic via browser profile; DeepSeek, OpenRouter via direct API) on a timer and writes a consolidated normalized JSON for the localweb2 dashboard.

tools.name: usage_scan
tools.description: Run a usage collection cycle NOW (all providers), bypassing the timer. Returns the consolidated normalized result: per-provider windows (kind: 5h|weekly|tpm-day|monthly|pool) with usedPct/used/limit/unit/resetAt, plus a stale[] list of providers that failed this cycle.

tools.name: usage_status
tools.description: Show usage-monitor health: timer state, last run timestamp and duration, per-provider last-success age and last error. Read-only.
